# netactuate_storage_object_stores (Data Source)

Reads Storage Object Stores visible to the account.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netactuate_storage_object_stores" "example" {
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `object_stores` (List of Object) Storage object stores visible to the account. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--object_stores))
